PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 6, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

Alvaro Castillo, Chair  Nicholas Santos, Commissioner
Michele Ware, Vice Chair  Griselda Suarez, Commissioner
Michael Clemson, Commissioner  Jane Templin, Commissioner
Todd Lemmis, Commissioner

  PLANNING COMMISSION IN-PERSON MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL COMMENTS
  TO PLANNINGCOMMISSIONERS@LONGBEACH.GOV

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION OR BY PRESSING *9 ON YOUR PHONE

  TO JOIN VIA ZOOM, PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 934 1096 4133
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/93410964133

 PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-
  PERSON ACCESS AND PUBLIC COMMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE AVAILABLE IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE BROWN ACT

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56911  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-56912  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission meeting of
  Thursday, October 2, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-56916  Recommendation to determine that the project is consistent with and within the
  scope of the project previously analyzed as part of General Plan Land Use and
  Urban Design Elements (LUE/UDE) Program Environmental Impact Report (SCH

  Page 1 of 3
   PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 6, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  No. 2015051054) and subject to the LUE/UDE Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting
  Program and warrants no further environmental review pursuant to California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Section 15183;

  Approve a Site Plan Review (SPR25-022), and adopt the proposed findings and
  conditions of approval related thereto, to allow the construction of an amphitheater
  event venue (Long Beach Amphitheater) with approximately 11,000 seats (with
  additional standing-room areas accommodating up to 12,000 persons in total
  capacity) on an approximately 7.1-acre site at the Queen Mary leasehold, currently
  used as a paved surface parking lot, located at 1051 Queens Highway within the
  Subarea 4 of Queensway Bay Planned Development (PD-21) District;

  Approve a Conditional Use Permit (CUP25-013), and adopt the proposed findings
  and conditions of approval related thereto, to allow the on-premises sale and
  consumption of alcoholic beverages (Alcoholic Beverage Control [ABC] Types 47,
  58, 68, and 77 Licenses) at the event venue; and

  Approve an Administrative Use Permit (AUP25-015), and adopt the proposed
  findings and conditions of approval related thereto, for the adjustment of parking
  requirements pursuant to Section 21.41.223 of the Zoning Regulations that would
  allow for implementation of a parking management plan and Transportation
  Demand Management (TDM) measures for event days at the event venue. (District
  1)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Planning Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Rosa Garibay, City Clerk Assistant, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101
or cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
